title: CWP/20300/2008 of JASVIR SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB ETC.
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 1156 Date of decision: 20.05.2025 Jasvir Singh ...Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and another ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMAN CHAUDHARY Present: Mr. Munish Gupta, Advocate for the petitioner. Ms. Shruti, AAG, Punjab. AMAN CHAUDHARY, J. (Oral)

1. Learned counsel submits that during the pendency of the present case, the petitioner was promoted as Principal, whereafter he retired on attaining the age of superannuation on 31.01.2025, however with regard to his claim for promotion as Senior Lecturer, he would file a representation to the respondents, which may be directed to be decided in a time bound manner, to which learned State counsel has no objection.

2. In view of the above and without commenting on the merits of the case, this petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to the respondents that in case a representation is filed within 4 weeks, the same be decided expeditiously in accordance with law, which this Court has no reason to believe the authorities would not address in a just, fair and reasonable manner. (AMAN CHAUDHARY) JUDGE 20.05.2025 Hemant
